description: Estimate HELOC payments: interest-only during the draw period and fully amortized payments during the repayment period.

faqs.a: A HELOC has two phases: a draw period (often 10 years) where you pay interest only, then a repayment period (often 20 years) where the balance amortizes like a loan.
faqs.q: What is a draw period vs repayment period?

faqs.a: Draw-phase payment = drawn balance × monthly interest rate. No principal is repaid during this phase.
faqs.q: How is the draw-phase payment calculated?

faqs.a: Most HELOCs have variable rates that can rise. This calculator uses a fixed rate you enter, so real payments could be higher.
faqs.q: Is my rate fixed on a HELOC?

howto: Enter the credit line limit, drawn amount and interest rate.
Set the draw period (interest-only) and repayment period lengths.
